Transport Projects and Channels

Transport Projects and Channels

One project at a time: 33 thousand transport works from ObrasGov.br, each given a readable name and matched by asset (highway, railway, urban rail line, airport, port) to the federal budget (SIGA), the Novo PAC portfolio, BNDES credit, external credit (COFIEX), subnational credit (SADIPEM) and the SOE investment budget (SEST). Bases and stages sit side by side and are never added. Companion to Financing Brazil's Infrastructure.

Financing channels at a glance

For each mode, the share of projects whose asset shows each financing channel. A project can show several channels, so bars do not add to 100%. Channels are observed at four levels (project, budget action, asset, municipality); this view uses the asset level.

What the filtered data says

    Channel by mode: share of projects or money observed

    Rows are channels, columns are modes. "Share" is the share of projects whose asset shows the channel; "R$ observed" is the amount recorded in the base that observes the channel, each at its own stage (hover a row for the stage). Never add rows.
    Read down a column: a mode with many coloured cells is financed through several channels on the same assets. Novo PAC is a label, not a channel: its OGU label is the federal budget already counted; its private label overlaps with BNDES credit to concessionaires.

    Projects with two or more channels, by level

    Share of projects with more than one financing channel at each observation level.
    share of projects
    Within the project, multiplicity is almost only "transfer + parliamentary amendment". Genuine multi-channel financing appears at the asset level: budget, concession and BNDES credit on the same highway, port or metro.

          What the concession contracts say

            The private channel, as declared. ANTT's SIGICOR cadastre lists the investment obligations of the federal highway concession contracts (the PER): one row per obligation with type, km, planned start and end and contract origin (original, amendment or rebalancing). The annual monitoring covers a small subset with planned and executed percentages by month. Everything is declared by the concessionaires; there are no amounts (the contract value is filled in 0.4% of rows) and stages are never summed. State roads delegated inside federal contracts (PR-xxx) stay under the contract. Download of 22 September 2026.

            Highways under concession, next to the other channels

            "Channels on the asset" now counts the concession from the contract itself (direct evidence), not only from the Novo PAC private label or a BNDES contract. Eleven highways keep the private label without any obligation in the cadastre: ended or re-tendered contracts (ViaBahia on BR-116 and BR-324 in Bahia, for instance).

            Same stretch, two channels

            DNIT works in ObrasGov whose km range overlaps concession obligations on the same highway (0.5 km tolerance; works citing several highways are left out because their km cannot be attributed). "Local" obligations span at most 50 km; long-stretch obligations (whole-contract maintenance) cover any point. Click a row to open the project record. Km references come from the work text and from the contract: indicative.

            Delay within type, by channel

            Comparable types only. Definitions differ by channel and are never mixed: DNIT delay is the minimum observed after the planned end (works not completed; physical execution is a snapshot); concession delay is estimated from the declared monthly pace. Read within a type; no conclusion is drawn.

            What the portfolio says

              A portfolio, not a flow. The Novo PAC list (June 2026) records transport and urban-mobility items with an estimated value for 2023–2030, a stage and a financing-source label. It is matched here to ObrasGov works by asset and municipality (automatic only when the names agree closely) and read as a source of labels: OGU is the federal budget already in SIGA; FIN is FGTS/BNDES/Caixa credit; private is the concession.

              What the credit bases say

                Two bases, two units. COFIEX lists external loans with loan and counterpart in US$; the export has no disbursement column, so "with disbursement" is proxied by a signed contract. SADIPEM lists credit requests of states and municipalities to STN in R$, linked to projects only through the borrower, never to a specific work.

                  What this dashboard is

                  The project layer of the thesis Financing Channels and the Quality of Infrastructure Investment: Evidence from Brazil. The main dashboard shows flows by channel; this one starts from the works registered in ObrasGov.br (download of 21 September 2026, 143,575 works, of which 33,327 transport) and asks, for each work and each asset, which financing channels can be observed in the other bases.

                  Names and categories

                  ObrasGov names are often contract numbers ("00 00895/2013") or budget codes ("26.782.2087.10IX.0031"). Each project therefore gets a generated name from its categories: type of intervention · asset or municipality · DNIT lot. Categories: mode and sub-category (from text, executor and system rules), intervention type (from text), size band (planned investment), situation, ObrasGov channel, and the origins of funds observed at four levels.

                  Bases and keys

                  • ObrasGov.br. Seven tables keyed by the unique identifier. Mode by explicit rules; 30 borderline cases per mode and the excluded candidates are kept for review.
                  • Asset key. Highway + state, railway, urban rail system by state, airport, port or waterway, corridor. The same extraction runs on every base, then a canonical form merges spellings.
                  • Federal budget (SIGA). Key A links 1,234 works to their budget action through the action label and the localizer's state (value stays on the action). Key B (commitment number, 37 thousand pairs) waits for a document-level SIAFI extraction.
                  • Novo PAC. 1,226 transport and urban-mobility items; candidates matched by asset or municipality with a name-similarity score; automatic only above 90 with the same municipality.
                  • ANTT (federal highway concessions). 20,496 contract obligations (PER) of 36 concessionaires keyed by highway + state; the annual monitoring covers 1,108 of them. Declared by the concessionaires, no amounts. The concession channel on an asset is evidenced by the contract obligation itself, added at build time to the asset and project channel strings (Concessions tab).
                  • BNDES, COFIEX, SADIPEM, SEST. 470 non-automatic contracts; external credit operations (US$); subnational credit requests (R$, linked by borrower); the SOE investment budget (R$).

                  Rules kept everywhere

                  • Planned, committed, paid, contracted, disbursed, estimated and realized are different stages: shown side by side, never summed.
                  • Multi-state works are never split; a work that touches two assets is listed under both.
                  • "Channel" counts origins of funds, not bases. Overlaps are flagged, not resolved.
                  • Physical execution is a snapshot; ObrasGov commitments start in 2018; the settled stage is unreliable in the source.
